scope: One-box Shareware material/placement trial using actual GameShelf_Show. Controlled angles are inspection poses only. No native app/process, game data, build, provider, commit or product source is modified.
visualAcceptance: Pending independent visual review and explicit owner acceptance. Edge statistics and matching dimensions alone do not prove aligned material.

materialWitnesses.meaning: Witness against the exact old flat fill only. Texture statistics and canvas dimensions do not establish visible alignment; inspect the flat wrap and actual oblique shelf views.
